name: block-stmt-test-58e33229dc/block-stmt-v.bal
spec_references: ## Statements: lists supported statements including "- [If/else]", "- [While]", "- [Local variable declarations]" and "- [Return]", but does not include standalone block statements.
## Expressions: "- [Anonymous function expression]" and "- [Type cast expression]".
reason: The case essentially tests standalone block statements: nested bare braces establish a local shadowing scope, contain a while loop, and contain assignments and returns. Standalone block statements are not covered by the supported Statements list, so the whole case is a feature even though its closure, arithmetic, casts and toString calls are covered.
unsupported_constructs: Standalone block statements, including block-local shadowing and return from a bare block.
test_design_notes: main asserts outputs 9, 8 and K25 and invokes equality checks for block scope, mutation and return behavior. No @args or @panic directives occur. io:println is output instrumentation.
